about: D6: the triage label for an issue, from the lane's allowlist (duplicate excluded: it needs other issues)
ask: The state is a software issue (`title`, `body`). Which one label fits it best?

criteria.bug: Something that exists is broken or behaves wrongly: a defect, a crash, a wrong result, a failing check.
criteria.enhancement: New capability, a change in behaviour, hardening, or a refactor asked for on purpose.
criteria.documentation: Only docs, comments, READMEs, SOPs, or handover text need to change.
criteria.question: Asks something, or needs a decision or information before any work.
criteria.invalid: Not actionable here: spam, wrong repository, empty, or nonsense.

fields.title: the config loader returns the wrong result when its input is empty
fields.body:
## Defect

`src/config/load.ts` treats an empty input as a success and returns a stale value from the previous call. Seen in the test log after a run with no repositories configured.

## Expected

An empty input yields an explicit "nothing to do" result.

## Done means

A test with an empty input fails today and passes after the fix.

fields.title: Add a bounded timeout to the retry scheduler
fields.body:
## Ask

`src/reconcile/retry.ts` waits without a limit on its upstream call. Add a configurable timeout (default 30 s) and report a timeout as a distinct error class.

## Done means

A test with a stalled upstream sees the timeout error within the limit.
